method.mcpByteAccounting: serializedContentBytes is Buffer.byteLength(JSON.stringify(result.content), 'utf8'); serializedStructuredContentBytes applies the same calculation to result.structuredContent. Neither includes the enclosing JSON-RPC message.
method.mcpCommand: Call inspect_code_graph over a real local stdio server with callerCwd=<intellij-checkout>, the recorded query and limits, and a 30 second client timeout.
method.pathPolicy: All machine-local paths are replaced with reviewed placeholders; the indexed repository and commit are public.

queryDiffHash.command: git diff -- src/code_graph/query.ts src/code_graph/store.ts src/code_graph/commands.ts src/mcp_server.ts | shasum -a 256
queryDiffHash.input: Raw unified-diff bytes emitted for those four tracked files relative to threadnoteBaseCommit at measurement time. It excludes every other path, untracked files, and staged-only changes.

method.sqlMethod: Call CodeGraphStore search and adjacency operations against the pinned ready snapshot in one Bun process after opening the 35.34 GB SQLite database.

notes: The direct SQL measurements exclude Git freshness observation and MCP serialization.
Overlay replacements, deletions, incoming/outgoing direction, self-loop deduplication, exact ranking, and bounded branch limits are covered by deterministic and property-based tests.

observations: Every result used the exact current Git snapshot and remained within the MCP graph response budget.

A persistent-server exact query remained about 4.3 seconds because exact worktree observation dominates the roughly 44 millisecond hot SQL read; watcher-backed invalidation was not assumed without proof.
Strict path and impact operations perform a second observation to prevent publishing a mixed-snapshot answer, explaining their higher end-to-end time.

An exact repository path now bypasses broad lexical candidate expansion; the TypeScript query fell from 6640.83 milliseconds to 3538.95 milliseconds and no longer exhausted the elapsed traversal budget.
